name: Outlaw (Rebel / Iconoclast)
motive: To break a structure that has stopped deserving its authority.
dread: Complicity: being domesticated by the thing you set out to fight.
shadow: The Nihilist: destruction becomes the point. It burns what works, offers nothing in its place, and calls the wreckage freedom.
example: The licence is a toll booth on your own work. Read clause nine, then read it again. We are not renewing, we are not negotiating, and the code goes out on Friday.
